projectDescription: Queme is a mobile app that keeps dog event participants and hosts connected in real time — with live run orders, check-in management, push notifications, and scoring tools.
keyFeatures: Real-time digital run orders with live updates
One-tap attendee check-in management for hosts
Push notifications for run order alerts and event changes
Bell-icon dog tracking for instant per-dog notifications
Custom dog statuses (Checked In, In Line, Running, Completed)
Live scoreboard viewable by all participants
Bark Messages — targeted alerts sent directly to a dog's followers
Excel import for bulk dog entry
Available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
publicApiSurface: Sign in with Google / Apple / Email
Add Dogs Manually or via Excel Import
Send Custom Notifications to event or run followers
Host Credit System (2 free event credits on upgrade)
